sections.description:
Notifal helps you display engaging messages and announcements to boost conversions and sales.

Best Plugin for Turning Visitors into Buyers (Boost Sales & Engagements) 🎯
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Old marketing strategies no longer work. You need smarter techniques to increase sales and engagement. We created Notifal, a notification and announcement plugin for WordPress, to help boost your sales & conversion. Hours of research into modern marketing techniques (FOMO, social proof…) have transformed into powerful features in Notifal!

🔎 View Live Demo | 📚 Documents | 👨‍💻 Support | 🔧 Free Configuration | 🌟 Get Notifal Pro

🟣 What is Notifal?

Notifal allows you to create and display various messages and announcements with specific goals. You can show:

  • Recent Sales (Build Trust & Social Proof)
  • Fake Sales (Build Trust & Social Proof)
  • Low Stock Alerts (Build Urgency & FOMO)
  • Product Discounts (Highlight Savings & Drive Conversions)
  • Sign-Up Forms (Turn Visitors into Registered Users – Need Elementor)
  • Newsletter Subscribe Forms (Turn visitors into Newsletter Subscribers – Need Elementor)
  • Floating Bars (Containing Forms, Timers, Buttons, Images… – Need Elementor)
  • Coupon Codes (Encourage Action & Boost Engagement)
  • Products Ordered in Last Day/Week/Month… (Show Popularity & Build Credibility)
  • Custom Messages (Like Link to pages, Link to Social Media, Notices…)
    and more…

Notifal’s advanced settings allow you to choose custom templates for each message. Additionally, you can personalize these templates to match your website’s design and brand colors. With conditions, you can control where and when different messages appear on various pages, giving you full flexibility!

🤝Notifal’s Powerful Integration with Elementor! (⭐PRO)

Version 1.2 introduces the powerful integration between Notifal and Elementor, allowing you to create and display fully customized and creative announcements to your website visitors.
With this feature, you can instantly turn visitors into registered users by displaying signup forms directly within popups.
Design floating bars that include forms, countdown timers, images, buttons, and more — all with Elementor’s drag-and-drop builder.
Here are some examples of creative features you can build using Notifal’s Elementor-powered templates:

🔎 What is FOMO marketing?

FOMO, or the Fear of Missing Out, is the feeling people experience when they sense they are missing out on something valuable. In modern marketing strategies, businesses leverage this emotion to encourage quicker customer actions. FOMO is a powerful driver in sales, and many sales techniques, such as limited-time discounts, tap into this fear. After extensive research, the Notifal team created Notifal to help businesses harness FOMO. Notifal triggers this feeling through features like WooCommerce popups, low stock alerts, and even fake sales, pushing users to act faster.
Read more about FOMO…

🌟 Building Social Proof with Notifal

Notifal isn’t just about FOMO! It helps you create social proof on your site, one of the most critical factors in marketing and sales. Social proof is the idea that people tend to follow the actions of others. If customers see that many others are buying a product, they’re more likely to trust it. Use Notifal to build social proof and boost sales.

🦾 Start Strong with Fake Sales

If you’re a new business with few sales, you might think Notifal isn’t for you. But Notifal offers a powerful feature for startups—fake sales popups! You can show fake activity, customize names, cities, and more, giving your site a sense of trustworthiness. Notifal’s algorithm ensures these fake events blend seamlessly, so your customers won’t suspect a thing. Start growing your business confidently!
Read more about: How to Create Fake Sales?

🎮 Take Control with Advanced Settings

Notifal’s advanced settings allow you to customize everything! The sections include:

  • Notification List:
    View or create new items (more than 1 only available in Pro). Change status here.
  • General Settings:
    Name your message and select target products.
  • Visual Settings:
    Customize templates, colors, animations, sounds, positions, and more, including custom CSS.
  • Source Settings:
    Choose between real or fake data, and customize fake sale details.
  • Condition Settings:
    Control which pages show specific designs.

📊 Notifal Analytics: Supercharge Your Sales with Actionable Data!

The Notifal Analytics feature provides everything you need to monitor, analyze, and optimize your notification performance. Understand your audience, enhance engagement, and track your sales with ease. With Notifal Analytics, every popup tells a story. make yours a success story!

  • Users (⭐PRO):
    Tracks the number of website users who have been shown popups. This helps you gauge the reach of your messages across your audience.

  • Impressions (⭐PRO):
    The total number of popups displayed on your website. This metric highlights how actively your messages are being shown to visitors.

  • Click Rate (⭐PRO):
    Displays the average click rate of your popups, revealing whether they are engaging enough to drive clicks or if they need improvements to capture interest.

  • Close Rate (⭐PRO):
    Indicates the average number of times users manually closed your popups. A high close rate may suggest that your popups are annoying users, giving you the opportunity to adjust them for better user experience.

  • Total Revenue:
    Shows the total revenue generated from Notifal popups, specifically for WooCommerce stores. This highlights the direct financial impact of your messages.

  • Products Sold via Notifal:
    Provides the total number of products sold through Notifal popups. This helps you understand the effectiveness of your messages in driving product sales.

  • Orders Influenced by Notifal:
    Displays the number of orders influenced by Notifal popups. This metric shows how many orders were impacted, giving you insights into their overall contribution to your store’s success.

💸 Who can benefit from Notifal?

✔ E-Commerce (Online shop on WooCommerce)
➜ Electronics
➜ Fashion and apparel
➜ Food
➜ Beverages
➜ DIY and hardware
➜ Furniture
➜ Beauty and personal care
➜ Toys and hobbies
➜ Educational (Online course…)
➜…
✔ Blog
✔ News
✔ Business
✔ Personal Websites
✔ Community
✔ Forum
✔…

💡 Get creative with tags!

Notifal gives you the tools to unleash your creativity through various tags. You can design your message text exactly how you like. It’s not a fixed template but fully customizable. Here are some tags we’ve provided for you:

  • {first_name}: Use this tag to display the buyer’s first name.
  • {last_name}: Use this tag to display the buyer’s last name.
  • {order_country}: Use this tag to show which country the buyer is from.
  • {order_state}: Use this tag to show which state the buyer is from.
  • {order_time}: Use this tag to show how many minutes/hours/days ago a product was sold.
  • {order_counter}: Use this tag to display the total number of sales in the last days/weeks/month…
  • {product_name}: Use this tag to display the product name.
  • {product_stock}: Use this tag to display the product stock level.
  • {product_link}: Use this tag to add the product page link. For example: href=”{product_link}”.
  • {product_regular_price}: Use this tag to display the original or non-discounted price of the product.
  • {product_sale_price}: Use this tag to display the product price after the discount.
  • {product_discount_amount}: Use this tag to display the product discount amount.
  • {product_discount_percent}: Use this tag to display the percentage discount of the product.
  • {product_discount_ends_in}: Use this tag to display the remaining time until the product discount ends.

Make your messages as unique as you want!🌟

🤝 We support you every step of the way!

No need to worry about support. Our team is dedicated to responding to tickets and requests as quickly as possible. Whether you need guidance or run into an issue, just leave it to us.

External services

This plugin connects to the Notifal API to submit feedback and feature requests when initiated by the user.

It sends:
* Site URL
* Admin Email Address
* Feedback/Feature Request details provided by the user

This is only sent when a user actively submits feedback or a feature request from within the plugin interface.

sections.installation:
1. Visit Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for Notifal
  3. Install Notifal once it appears
  4. Activate Notifal from your Plugins page.
  5. Go to “after activation” below.

Manually

  1. Upload the notifal folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the Notifal plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to “after activation” below.

After activation

  1. You should see the Notifal in the WordPress menu.
  2. Click on Add new to create your first notification or use default notifications.
  3. You’re done!
sections.faq:
Do you guarantee an increase in sales with Notifal?

Let’s be honest! no one can guarantee sales. However, using modern marketing techniques like FOMO and social proof is essential for boosting sales. Notifal helps by displaying sales notification effectively.

Do I need marketing knowledge to use Notifal?

No, you don’t need to be a marketing expert. Notifal is designed to be user-friendly, making it easy for anyone to implement FOMO and social proof without any marketing experience.

Do I need coding skills to use Notifal?

Not at all. Notifal’s intuitive interface allows you to manage everything without needing coding skills.

I run a new store with no sales yet. Can Notifal help me?

Yes, Notifal’s fake sale notification feature helps new stores build trust and kickstart sales. You can display fake notifications with custom names, cities, and more to create the perception of activity on your store.

Will customers notice fake sales notification?

No, fake notifications look exactly like real ones. After a successful purchase, customers immediately see their own details in a notification, building trust.

Will notifications annoy my site visitors?

Reactions to notifications vary. Some customers benefit from seeing them, while others might find them distracting. Notifal includes a setting that stops showing notifications if a user closes one, ensuring a better user experience.

Can I customize notifications?

Absolutely. Notifal offers full customization options for notification templates, colors, animations, sounds, and more.

Can I select specific products to display in sales notification?

Yes, you can choose to display sales notification for either specific products or all products in your store.

Can I have different notification designs for different pages?

In the Pro version, you can create multiple notifications with unique designs for different pages. For example, you might want a dark theme on a landing page and a light theme elsewhere. This flexibility is available in the Pro version but limited in the free version.

How do I know if Notifal will conflict with my theme or other plugins?

We test Notifal extensively to ensure compatibility with popular themes and plugins. If you encounter any issues, report them through our support channels at Notifal.com, and we’ll address them quickly.

Do you offer support?

Yes! Whether you’re using the free or Pro version, we offer full support to address any issues. Our goal is to assist you and continuously improve the plugin based on your feedback.
